{{Quote|When Moff Garreter mobilized his fleet to assist Head of State Fel, Moff Woolbam attempted to annex Rimcee Station. Garreter was forced to divert to protect the integrity of his holdings.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
An '''attack''' of [[Rimcee Station]] took place in [[44 ABY]]. During the last stages of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] and a number of rebellious [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] attempted a coup to overthrow [[Jagged Fel]], the rightful [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the one-month long [[Battle over Exodo II]] that opposed Fel's and Daala's fleets, numerous troubles erupted in [[Imperial Space]]. As most element of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]] were involved in the battle, traitorous Moffs used the opportunity to settle old disputes and expand their territories by attacking rival Imperial [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. In the [[Rimcee system]], the treacherous Moff [[Woolbam]] attempted to annex [[Rimcee Station]]. Moff [[Garreter]], who had mobilized his fleet to assist Head of State Fel, was forced to divert his forces to protect his holdings and repel the invader. The disastrous situation in Imperial space eventually led to the organization of a [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|general Imperial election]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
